title: Tiny, cute toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle body -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='14' height='50' rx='7' fill='#3fc7f0'/>
  <!-- grip bands -->
  <rect x='44' y='60' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8fe6ff'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8fe6ff'/>
  <!-- handle shine -->
  <rect x='47' y='42' width='4' height='44' rx='2' fill='#c7f3ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='30' width='12' height='14' rx='4' fill='#3fc7f0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='38' y='14' width='26' height='22' rx='9' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
  <rect x='38' y='14' width='26' height='22' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#b9d9ee' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bristles -->
  <rect x='41' y='6' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='4' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='51' y='4' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='6' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <rect x='41' y='6' width='3' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd25e'/>
  <rect x='46' y='4' width='3' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd25e'/>
  <rect x='51' y='4' width='3' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd25e'/>
  <rect x='56' y='6' width='3' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd25e'/>
  <!-- cute face on head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#1e3a4f'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#1e3a4f'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='23.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='23.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M48 29 q3 2.5 6 0' stroke='#1e3a4f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- toothpaste blob on brush head -->
  <path d='M40 16 q6 -6 12 -1 q6 5 11 -1 q2 5 -3 7 q-8 4 -17 -1 q-3 -2 -3 -4z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.0'/>
